abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 03 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78039-1 Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals are an emerging class of materials in which nematic orientational order coexists with spontaneous macroscopic polarization. Vats et al. develop a free-energy framework to rationalize their bulk structures and predict potential bend-instability-driven mesophases.

title: Cooper pairs found above superconducting critical temperature in pair density waves
title_zh: 在对密度波中发现高于超导临界温度的库珀对
summary: 伊利诺伊大学香槟分校格兰杰工程学院的物理学家发现了一种新形式的超导行为。对金属二碲化铀的实验表明，库珀对（负责超导性的复合电子单元）可以组织成不均匀的图案，即使在主超导相不存在时也存在这种图案。
abstract: Physicists with the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign's Grainger College of Engineering have identified a new form of superconducting behavior. Experiments on the metal uranium ditelluride reveal that Cooper pairs, the composite electron units responsible for superconductivity, can organize into nonuniform patterns that exist even when the main superconducting phase is absent.

title: Scientists discover first type I superconductor that breaks time-reversal symmetry
title_zh: 科学家发现第一个打破时间反转对称性的I型超导体
summary: 超导体是无电阻导电并在冷却至超低温时释放磁场的材料。根据它们的量子结构，它们还可以展示磁悬浮等奇怪的特性。但现在事情变得有点奇怪了。
abstract: Superconductors are materials that conduct electricity with no resistance and expel magnetic fields when cooled to ultralow temperatures. And depending on their quantum structure, they can also showcase strange properties like magnetic levitation. But now things are getting a little weirder.
